wallet_invites_pending_unique.name: wallet_invites_pending_unique
wallet_invites_pending_unique.where: "wallet_invites"."accepted_at" is null and "wallet_invites"."declined_at" is null and "wallet_invites"."revoked_at" is null

wallet_ownership_transfers_pending_uniqu.name: wallet_ownership_transfers_pending_unique
wallet_ownership_transfers_pending_uniqu.where: "wallet_ownership_transfers"."accepted_at" is null and "wallet_ownership_transfers"."declined_at" is null and "wallet_ownership_transfers"."canceled_at" is null

categories_owner_check.name: categories_owner_check
categories_owner_check.value:
("categories"."is_system" and "categories"."wallet_id" is null and "categories"."translation_key" is not null)
        or (not "categories"."is_system" and "categories"."wallet_id" is not null and "categories"."name" is not null)

transactions_invoice_check.name: transactions_invoice_check
transactions_invoice_check.value: "transactions"."invoice_id" is null or "transactions"."credit_card_id" is not null

transactions_installments_check.name: transactions_installments_check
transactions_installments_check.value:
num_nonnulls("transactions"."installment_group_id", "transactions"."installment_number", "transactions"."installment_total") in (0, 3)
        and ("transactions"."installment_number" is null or "transactions"."installment_number" between 1 and "transactions"."installment_total")
